observed: Compose built its runtime image and started with zero apps.
Owner API installed a module backend and the in-container CLI invoked it through a Docker lease.
Separate release hostname required its own launch cookie and hid backend source.
Gateway forwarded authenticated frontend backend requests to the container.
Compose restart preserved app data and reattached the same compute lease.
Idle workers stopped safely and their containers/networks were removed without force.
limits: Real Linux Docker Compose acceptance; no graphical browser or desktop Docker-engine acceptance.
External domains/TLS, cloud provisioning and managed desktop engines are separate checks.
